title: When the phone is locked, AAPS disconnects and stops running
body: Huawei/Honor phone, patch pump + AAPS. Whenever the phone screen is locked for about an hour, AAPS disconnects, including the glucose data link. This happens because AAPS does not have a direct data source option for the Sibionics CGM. My setup: Sibionics official app + xdrip + AAPS + patch pump.

comments.body:
Did you disable Power management for AAPS, Xdrip and Sibionics App? AAPS doesn't need direct source if you are using Xdrip... Not all phones can be made to work with AAPS and Xdrip. One has nothing to do with other things. Problem is that Huawei's power management shuts down all services that he thinks are not in use... Xdrip has some extended options that handle power management, but not all phones are supported (you have to enable Samsung Hack - which works on other phones too, question is if it works with yours). 

Best solution is to get phone that is compatible with AAPS and Xdrip (there is compatibility list somewhere where you can find which phones are compatible), not other way around...
